items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: I've been working with Ory since... I've been with Ory ever since, up to 1957.

ctx.x: He had opened up. No, here. In Los Angeles? Yes. He left Oakland and came down here. At that time, Texas dance was going on there. Well, I never knew. I thought you stayed out here on the coast. I never knew you were back in Chicago.

No, I went back in Chicago. Yes. So, pardon me, so after this mess come up, so I said I'd better take this job. Well, in the meantime, I bought my own ticket. He didn't have to send it for me. I wanted to get away from Chicago. So when I came back to Los Angeles, the drummer they had had given me his two weeks notice. Well, the lady was working for her, he went singing the blues to her, so she changed it, and she fired him. That'd take the whole band of some mess to the head. Well, anyhow, they voted on the…
That Taxi Dance Hall, was that on 3rd Street?
